name: Single-disc
blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on CSR. v0.2.3: fixes v0.2.2 LOST2 (#634) background graphical corruption after the D1->D2 break scene (the IFUW gate fix was recompressing the whole field with a from-scratch LZS encoder; now patches the single else-jump byte directly in the compressed data instead). Retains the v0.2.2 D1->D2 black screen fix and the FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN embedded table fix (Makou Reactor save). Manip movies and endings are disabled pending re-validation on this new base.
hint: CSR. Fields-only core; movies/endings not yet re-enabled.
betaNote: v0.2.3: fixes the v0.2.2 regression where the LOST2 (#634) break-scene IFUW gate fix decompressed and recompressed the whole field with a from-scratch LZS encoder, which round-tripped correctly through this repo's own decoder but produced a background that rendered corrupted/garbled on real hardware and DuckStation. Now patches the single else-jump byte directly inside the still-compressed LZS body, so the rebuilt LOST2.DAT differs from pristine CSR Disc 2's LOST2.DAT by exactly that one byte. Retains the v0.2.2 D1->D2 black screen fix (proven pre-exported DSKCG-stripped BLACKBGB/E/3) and the FIELD.BIN/WORLD.BIN table fix (resolves Invalid archive Makou Reactor saves). Manip movies and endings are currently disabled while this core is playtested standalone.
